# ARKhives 8.21.4

ARKdaily now mixes recall posts from Famous Buildings, Philippine Historical Churches and Visual Dictionary into its randomized feed. Dedicated recall slots and collection rotation prevent large MCQ explanation banks from crowding them out. MCQs and quick facts remain in the mix.

Visual Dictionary is stored as MCQs. Daily presents its existing question, mapped image and keyed answer as a tap-to-reveal recall view, without converting the study bank or changing progress. Famous Buildings and church cards retain their front/back text and images.

Subject data loads in a small bounded batch and is cached for reuse instead of fetching per card. Rendered questions do not repeat, and changing accounts clears the discovery pools. Unpublished, retired and quarantined content is excluded.

The supplied Tiko engine, motion, sound, glass styling and existing-hint behavior from 8.21.3 are preserved. Daily still awards no FSRS ratings or study credit.
